relations.text: 年次報告で、台湾のファウンドリであるTSMCへの販売が売上の重要な部分を占めるとしている
relations.text_en: The annual report says Onto derives substantial revenue from sales to semiconductor device foundries in Taiwan such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd.

source.label: Onto Innovation 10-K
source.quote: types of events on our revenue and cash flows could be material because we derive substantial revenue from sales to semiconductor device foundries in Taiwan such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd., from memory chip manufacturers in South Korea such as Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., and from semiconductor device manufacturers in Japan

relations.text: TSMCと共同で、先端ロジック向けにAtlasプラットフォームを用いた独自のプロセス制御ソリューションを開発した

source.quote: Working together, TSMC and Onto have developed unique process control solutions for advanced logic applications using our Atlas® platform
source.note: 2023年の発表で、やや古い情報です。

companies.name: リガク・ホールディングス

relations.text: リガクが、Onto Innovationと戦略的な資本・事業提携を結んだと発表した
relations.text_en: Rigaku announced a strategic capital and business alliance with Onto Innovation

source.label: Rigaku の発表
source.quote: Rigaku Holdings Corporation (headquarters: Akishima, Tokyo; President and CEO: Jun Kawakami; “Rigaku”), a global leader in X-ray analytical technologies, today announced that it has entered into a strategic capital and business alliance with Onto Innovation Inc.

relations.text: Ontoがリガクの株式27%(少数株主持分)の取得を完了した
relations.text_en: Onto completed the acquisition of a 27% minority equity stake in Rigaku

source.label: Onto Innovation の発表
source.quote: Onto Innovation Inc. (NYSE: ONTO) today announced the successful closing of its previously announced acquisition of a 27% minority equity stake in Rigaku Holdings Corporation

relations.text: Ontoは、HBM向けの欠陥防止システムの開発により、SK hynixから技術功績のBest Partner Awardを受けた
relations.text_en: Onto received the Best Partner Award for technology achievement from SK hynix for a defect prevention system for HBM applications

source.label: Onto Innovation の発表
source.quote: SK hynix bestowed the honor on Onto, the only company recognized for technology achievement, for developing a defect prevention system with breakthrough measurement technology for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) applications.
